name: fungos/cr
description: Single-file header-only C/C++ library for hot-reloading binary plugins at runtime, with automatic crash detection, rollback to previous working versions, and static state transfer across Linux, macOS, and Windows.
score_rationale: The go-to header-only solution for C/C++ hot reload with 1.7k stars, MIT licensed, and actively maintained through March 2025 — widely used in game engines for live coding workflows.
summary: Header-only C/C++ library for runtime hot-reloading with crash detection
